{{recipe}} 

Top sirloin is a great beef bargain. It's juicy and flavorful when cooked properly.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 top [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|sirloin]] steak (also known as top butt, center cut sirloin, or hip steak)
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], room temperature

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steak with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Place steak on a high [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Cook 1 minute, then rotate 90° and cook for another 1 minute. Flip and repeat this process for the other side.
#Move to medium heat and cook, turning often, until desired "doneness" is achieved.
#Remove to a plate and top with butter. Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] and let rest 10 minutes.
#Slice thinly across the grain on a bias. Serve warm.
